name: Greg Allocca
notes: Self-portrayal, v105(a): the wing's own owner/President & CEO, billed in full as Joseph Gregory Allocca on his own 26 September 1998 press conference, calling matches as color commentator and briefly intervening in-ring during the 13 October 1998 Test of the Best main event.

name: Tecate
notes: Announced signed \"from the far east in Japan\" at the 26 September 1998 press conference; a masked heavyweight billed at 6'10\", 325 lbs on the Test of the Best broadcast.
caption: A masked heavyweight signed ahead of the promotion's October 1998 restart; fought \"Lightning\" Levi Ash to a double countout.

tenures.source: named signed at the 26 September 1998 press conference; fights to a double countout draw on the 13 October 1998 Test of the Best broadcast

name: Edward Mason
notes: The self-proclaimed \"King of Hardcore,\" already on the promotion's roster for its 15 February 1998 restart (a trash-can hardcore win over Serial Killer); wins the 13 October 1998 Test of the Best main event, a 3 Way Dance, over The Excalibur and Markus King using a concealed set of knuckles under the card's no-disqualification rule, becoming the #1 seed for a promised ICW Tournament.
caption: The self-proclaimed \"King of Hardcore\"; on the roster since February 1998, he won the October 1998 Test of the Best 3 Way Dance main event to become the promotion's #1 tournament seed.

tenures.source: the promotion's own 15 February 1998 Saturday Slamfest restart and 13 October 1998 Test of the Best broadcasts

name: Markus King
notes: Billed \"one of the top indies wrestlers for almost a year\" and under negotiation at the 26 September 1998 press conference; billed from Milwaukee, Wisconsin, nicknamed \"Triple X,\" on the Test of the Best broadcast, where he lost the 3 Way Dance main event.
caption: A Milwaukee-billed wrestler nicknamed \"Triple X\"; lost the October 1998 Test of the Best 3 Way Dance main event to Edward Mason.

tenures.source: named under negotiation at the 26 September 1998 press conference; fights the Test of the Best main event, 13 October 1998
